hedge_rates_1y.method: no market forward points were found for end-2025, so hedges use covered interest parity on 1Y fixings (WIBOR 1Y 3.78%, EURIBOR 12M 2.25% ACT/360, 1Y T-bill 3.47%) of 30 Dec 2025. With NBP cuts priced, the FX-implied PLN rate is likely below WIBOR 1Y, so these pickups are probably an upper bound
